The per-namespace attribution of the major is derived by the coder from the key(s) the manager named, not from the auditor's per-namespace verdict. target_sha256 is the namespace file's SHA-256 at recording time; per the manager the file was not edited after this audit. Evidence is the translators' and auditors' own reports as relayed to the coder by the manager, not coder-invented output; verdict counts span all nine namespaces of the locale and are repeated in every row. Per-finding text lives in the audit reports and the PR thread (damianvtran/local-operator#3597); unresolved minors/nits are deferred, not fixed. Dates are the day the coder recorded the row.

Whole namespace read at the new bytes against en source; source/context/target sha256 re-derived from disk and match the translator draft.
